about.title: About
about.description: The first board game company built entirely in the open. CC BY-SA rules, MIT engines, forkable rulebooks in git. Founded in Kuala Lumpur, incorporated in the UK.

roadmap.title: Roadmap
roadmap.description: Our public 18-month roadmap. Physical production, online engines, marketplace, and community tools.

community.title: Community
community.description: Join the Moddable.Games community on Discord. Playtesters, designers, and rule-tinkerers building open-source board games together.

press.title: Press Kit
press.description: Moddable.Games press kit. Logos, screenshots, brand colours, and contact details for editorial use.

team.title: Team
team.description: Meet the team behind Moddable.Games. Four people building open-source board games.

subscribe.title: Subscribe
subscribe.description: Get updates on new mods, games, and tools from Moddable.Games.

submit.title: Submit a Mod
submit.description: Submit your board game mod to the Moddable.Games library. Open to all designers.

developers.title: Developers
developers.description: Build on Moddable engines. APIs, SDKs, and embeddable game tools for developers.

mods.title: Mods
mods.description: Browse our library of open-source rulebook mods for board games you already own.

games.title: Games
games.description: Original games designed to be modded from day one — Nukes, Planet Mongo, Endless Skies.

engines.title: Engines
engines.description: Open-source game engines anyone can embed, extend, or fork. Moddable Chess and Moddable Hexmaps.

news.title: News
news.description: Essays, announcements, and build logs from Moddable.Games. Written by humans, for humans.
